scope: All biology-domain queries in the pinned real-data metadata: 26 query variants from ten claim groups and two studies. Synthetic metadata is excluded. Published train/test partitions do not create splits in our single-train collection.
pattern_scope: Manually inferred from public questions and metadata. Patterns may include prerequisites shared by a claim group; individual endpoints need separate coverage assessment.

tasks.assessment: Permitted public query description manually assessed; hypotheses, target values and biological fixtures are excluded. Sibling query variants are grouped explicitly.
required_stages: join introduction records and time periods
scientific_decisions: Keep observation effort and period coverage explicit; changes in composition do not establish causal replacement.
Use a neutral question and derive the conclusion from data; a presupposed relationship in a source prompt is not reference evidence.
remaining_gaps: Keep observation effort and period coverage explicit; changes in composition do not establish causal replacement.
The original hypothesis judge is not an executable numerical contract; author and validate structured outputs on independent real observations.
